purpose: Constrain the next Campaign114 step to deterministic metadata-only discovery of official SSE and SZSE information-disclosure evaluation archives, without observing issuer grades, attachments, factor values, prices, or returns.

selected_source_family.name: official_exchange_information_disclosure_evaluation_grade
selected_source_family.semantic_unit: one official annual issuer-level disclosure-work evaluation grade
selected_source_family.reason_mapping_not_frozen: No issuer row or attachment may be opened until metadata proves the exact finite grade vocabulary used by both exchanges. A later mapping must be frozen from official schema or explanatory metadata before any issuer-grade row is exposed; otherwise the source terminates.

permitted_metadata_only_actions: Navigate or query public unsigned official SSE and SZSE static search, navigation or index pages using only the finite search vocabulary.
Record the official page URL, catalog or page identifier, exact visible archive labels, publication date labels, pagination metadata and attachment href without opening the attachment.
Hash the literal official page URL or attachment href as a document-identity candidate without requesting its bytes.
Record a zero-result, transport, response-shape, missing-year or missing-role failure without retrying through a different source family.
forbidden_actions: Open, download, screenshot, parse, hash or count any PDF, XLS, XLSX, CSV, ZIP or other evaluation attachment.
Read, persist, count or infer any issuer code, issuer name, evaluation year or grade row from an attachment, list response or page body.
Use search-engine snippets as source evidence beyond documenting discovery failure.
Use cookies, credentials, signed-in browser state, proxy rotation, anti-bot workarounds or provider tokens.
Use a third-party mirror, news report, broker report, manual name matching, OCR or text mining to fill a missing exchange, year, role or grade vocabulary.
Drop either exchange, change the source family, widen the search vocabulary after observing results, or infer a grade mapping from issuer rows.
Read candidate values, any of the 134 comparator values, historical daily prices, forward returns or 2024-2025 stress data.
mandatory_later_freeze_before_any_attach: exact official endpoints, archive identifiers and permitted request parameters
pure schema-role and canonicalization adapter implemented only with synthetic fixtures
exact grade vocabulary and numeric mapping
publication-time availability rule, signal window, missing semantics and raw range
atomic source-acceptance workflow, data/code fingerprints and tests
